note: RERUN3 of gc-idle-gate-time-1117 (11-19). rerun2 smoke STOPped 'profiler cut short (475 of 600 s)' (3rd time: 11-18 smoke-r2 480/600, 11-19 smoke 487 and r2 475). Cause: harness. The profiler ran the full 600 s (rows t span 599 s, 'done; game alive'); 18 sim stalls of 5-9 s (135 s) leave no seconds.csv row, and runInvalid counted rows. Fixed: worst-hitches.ts coveredSecs (row time span, bugfix/profiler-cut-short-stalls-1119). Open: these 4 s+ stalls run 11-40 per 10 min in every gchold1/gchold2 run, both arms (off arm too), vs 0-6 on other BP builds: likely ours (gate install) or the build set, not proven; read BP hitches >=1000 ms per arm before any verdict. Rest as rerun2: rerun1 smoke STOPped on noise (og 24% incl. kernel with the sweep on; fixed: machine-load.ts ruleOf uses apps on the game CPUs) and on a smoke that could not split (10-min smoke, 5-min slices = warm-up + one off slice). Change vs rerun1: declared smoke = bp-gcgate-ab at 10 min with 2-min slices (warm-up + off,on,on,off). Rest as rerun1: (original result docs/281 §8.8: invalid, other CPU 24-25% on game cores, <4 iterations per arm, SV VOID). Same builds/arms/ini/saves as the original (asi gchold2-1117, ini master-1117c, ts3fixes dalexlol-1117b). Change: 45 min per world = 5-min slices, warm-up on + TWO ABBA blocks (off,on,on,off,off,on,on,off) = 4 off + 4 on slices (>= 4 iterations per arm, 20 min per arm), timeoutMin 65. SV VOID cause (not a profiler stop): the profiler writes a seconds.csv row only when a sim iteration arrives, so seconds inside the SV world 1 s+ stalls (9.6 min of >=1000 ms hitches) have no row; 1099 rows < 0.8 x 1500 s tripped runInvalid (worst-hitches.ts:261). The profiler itself ran the full 1500 s (log ends normally). The rerun keeps the 0.8 rule: expect SV VOID again unless stalls are fewer; if so read the numbers from profile-compare.mjs (rows are per sim second, stalls drop out of both arms) and fix the row rule in worst-hitches.ts between jobs. TIMING: needs a quiet machine (Spotify, IDE, java, BackgroundDownload closed, other CPU < 10%). Read per job: node tools/harness/wait-ab.ts <tag> --counters gcgMs,gcgForcedMs,gcgForced,gcgCycles,gcgSkipped,gcgCalls; node tools/profile-compare.mjs <tag>:on <tag>:off. Pass criteria as in the original. Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/gc-idle-gate-time-1117-rerun2-1118.json
